notes: 旅莊望岳園 has no own website (research F138: 沒有官網; the 観光協会 page links only to Rakuten Travel), so official is its 層雲峡観光協会 page.
民宿Todate's site http://m-todate.com/ is plain HTTP (no HTTPS) and Shift_JIS; it opens with 200.

ANSHINDO's site efc.hokkaido.jp/anshindo returns 200 with the right title (ANSHINDO｜北海道上川町のマイクロホテル…), but the body needs JavaScript to show. If that is a concern, the 層雲峡観光協会 page https://sounkyo.net/stay/detail.html?content=106 also works (200).
HOTEL KUMOI: map query uses the Japanese signboard name ホテル雲井 (the site title is ホテル雲井); 'HOTEL KUMOI 上川町' is an equivalent alternative.
大雪飯店 and 層雲閣: map queries use the short name ホテル大雪 and the full 層雲閣MOUNTAIN RESORT 1923, as shown on the 観光協会 list.
朝陽度假飯店: the official name is 層雲峡温泉 朝陽リゾートホテル; the query drops the 層雲峡温泉 prefix but keeps 上川町.
愛山溪溫泉 is in the mountains of 上川町 (愛山渓), about 30 minutes by car from JR上川駅; seasonal (May–Oct). Official site is the current operator NPO法人かむい's site.
